grocery.copyText.content:
Shopping day: Sunday

Produce
  [x] 2 cup bagged slaw mix
  [x] 1 each banana
  [ ] 0.5 cup basil
  [ ] 3 tbsp cilantro
  [ ] 2 each cucumber
  [ ] 8 clove garlic
  [ ] 1 each lemon
  [ ] 5 tbsp parsley
  [ ] 2 each scallion
  [ ] 2 tbsp sesame ginger dressing
  [ ] 2 each tomato

Proteins & Dairy
  [ ] 5 oz cooked chicken breast
  [ ] 0.5 cup egg whites
  [ ] 2 each eggs
  [ ] 3 oz fresh mozzarella
  [ ] 0.5 cup greek yogurt
  [ ] 1 cup oat milk
  [ ] 16 oz rotisserie chicken breast

Pantry
  [ ] 1 tsp balsamic glaze
  [ ] 1 can cannellini beans
  [ ] 2 tsp coconut aminos
  [ ] 1 cup cooked rice
  [ ] 1 tsp coriander
  [ ] 0.5 cup hummus
  [ ] 2 pouch microwave rice pouch
  [ ] 2 tsp olive oil
  [ ] 40 g pea protein powder
  [ ] 1 tbsp piri-piri sauce
  [ ] 1 each pita
  [ ] 3 tbsp walnuts

Frozen
  [ ] 0.75 cup frozen berries

formulas.label: BMR (Mifflin-St Jeor)
formulas.formula: 10 x kg + 6.25 x cm - 5 x age - 161

formulas.label: Rest-day calories
formulas.formula: (weekly average x 7 - training kcal x training days) / rest days

recipes.name: Gochujang Beef Bowl
steps: Brown beef with garlic
Stir in gochujang, coconut aminos, honey, sesame oil
Serve one portion over rice with cucumber and scallions
Refrigerate the second portion promptly; eat within 1 day

Refrigerate the second portion promptly; eat within 1 day

context.get.content:
# Nutrition context

Copy this to `nutrition-context.md` (gitignored) and replace it with your own
notes, or just edit it in the app at `/context`.

This file is free text on purpose. It holds the things that don't belong in a
schema — the reasons behind the numbers, what's actually been working, what to
raise at the next check-in. The app renders it and writes back to it; nothing
here is parsed.

## Goal

Gain muscle, lose fat, longevity.

## What's working

Meals that have felt good, timings that fit the week, anything worth repeating.

## What isn't

Dishes that sat badly, days the plan didn't survive contact with reality.

## Constraints worth remembering

No high-histamine foods or seasonings. Consider a ingredients and how they might work with MCAS.

## Questions for the next check-in

Things to ask a coach, dietitian or doctor.
